blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The Iligan City government, the Department of the Interior and Local Government – Region 10 (DILG-10), and the Iligan City People’s Council (ICPC) have signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MOU) to establish a Civil Society Organization (CSO) Academy here, a pilot program aimed at strengthening CSOs in local governance.
